sources.author: faviann
sources.title: Controlled scenario: frozen Validation-surface omission
sources.body:
## Controlled scenario

Add `bin/report-members`, a command that reports the repository's complete
trusted member collection in the exact order `alpha`, `beta`, `gamma`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The finite Validation surface is exactly the three concrete files
  `fixtures/members/alpha.txt`, `fixtures/members/beta.txt`, and
  `fixtures/members/gamma.txt`.
- [ ] `bin/report-members` emits one `name=value` line for each of those three
  members in `alpha`, `beta`, `gamma` order.
- [ ] Each listed member has direct black-box evidence that would fail if its
  line were absent or incorrect.
- [ ] `bash test.sh` passes.

## Scope

This is a disposable controlled-policy fixture. Do not add or remove collection
members, infer members dynamically, or change `POLICY.md`.
